observed_failure.root_cause: Runtime compatibility maintenance rewrote filenames inside the immutable embedded schema authority, changing approved authority bytes.

candidate_invariant: Runtime compatibility or maintenance patches MUST operate outside immutable embedded authority literals. Embedded schema and approval declarations must be protected from edits and must be byte-identical before/after maintenance; their frozen SHA-256 values must recompute exactly. Any authority-byte change is a hard failure requiring a new authority version, not a runtime patch.
general_scope: All self-contained Zotero Run-JavaScript runtimes that embed frozen schema, approval, contract, or other immutable authority bytes.
positive_controls: Extract embedded authority declaration before patching.
Replace authority declaration with non-colliding placeholder while patching runtime code.
Restore exact declaration bytes after patching.
Recompute exact frozen SHA after patching.
Require independent writer/auditor authority declarations to be identical.
negative_control: A patch that changes a filename, version string, whitespace, line ending, or any other byte inside an immutable authority literal MUST fail.
promotion_rule: Promote only after V1R4 runtime successors PASS and historical calibration retest shows no regression in NUS-172/NUS-48 authority-preservation behavior.
